# POSsteg
Code and data for POSsteg, a linguistic steganography method that hides messages in LLM-generated text by controlling the part-of-speech (POS) tags of generated words.
## Repository structure

* `notebooks/POSsteg.ipynb` – the method (encoding and decoding), generation of the stego/cover corpus and the message-length experiment
* `notebooks/length_experiment_extension.ipynb` – extension of the message-length experiment with an additional prompt and hidden message
* `notebooks/additional_experiments.ipynb` – cover texts generated by greedy decoding and text-quality scores from a second judge (Claude Opus 4.7)
* `notebooks/analysis/` – analyses reported in the paper (text quality, steganalysis, capacity, message length)
* `notebooks/analysis/decoding_analysis_lg.ipynb`, `notebooks/analysis/decoding_analysis_3.7.5.ipynb` – decoding of the corpus with `en_core_web_lg` 3.8.0 (spaCy 3.8) and `en_core_web_trf` 3.7.3 (spaCy 3.7.5)
* `notebooks/analysis/figure2_check.ipynb` – decoding of the example text in Figure 2
* `results/generated_corpus.jsonl` – corpus of 272 stego-cover text pairs used in the paper
* `results/generated_corpus_greedy.jsonl` – the stego texts of the corpus paired with cover texts generated by greedy decoding
* `results/generated_corpus_two_judges.jsonl` – the corpus with additional text-quality scores from Claude Opus 4.7
* `results/length_experiment_results.jsonl` – results of the message-length experiment
